subject: Initiate vendor security questionnaire: SIG/custom selection + evidence clarifications
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@aperture.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initiate vendor security questionnaire: SIG/custom selection + evidence clarifications

Hi Lina — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick follow-up to kick off the security questionnaire work and align on scope so we can get you the right artifacts fast.

Summary of ask: we usually run either the SIG (standard) or a short custom form depending on the depth you need. From our discovery: Aperture will evaluate for potential HIPAA scope and EU residency isn't required at this time. A couple of clarifying questions so we route correctly: 

- Do you want the full SIG (CAIQ-like) or a condensed prefill bundle? (SIG gives more granular controls; prefill is faster)
- Is HIPAA the primary compliance driver, or are you also validating GDPR controller/processor responsibilities?
- Expected usage pattern: Are the API calls going to include PHI (e.g., names, SSNs) or only pseudonymized attributes? Approx monthly QPS/token volume would help determine hosting/evidence needs.
- Required artifacts: Do you prefer a SOC 2 Type II report + description, or would the SOC 2 summary + system description be sufficient to start? Deadline for vendor review?

Action items for Aperture: please reply with choice (SIG vs prefill), confirm whether PHI is present, and share any required timeline. I'll attach our SOC 2 summary and the prefill template in case you want to start with that.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (summary extract), redwood-sig-mapping-template.xlsx (prefill template)

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park | Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0212
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@aperture.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initiate vendor security questionnaire: SIG/custom selection + evidence clarifications

Hi Kim — great to connect. Aperture's security team prefers the SIG if possible — we need the granular view for our supply chain checklist. A few answers below: 

- SIG vs Prefill: SIG (full) preferred.
- Compliance drivers: HIPAA is the initial requirement; GDPR questions are secondary but please include data processing descriptions.
- PHI: We will be sending limited PHI (medical identifiers + timestamps) in early pilots.
- Timeline: our internal review needs the initial packet within 10 business days; final approval target in ~6 weeks.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: 
  1) SOC 2 Type II report (or at minimum a cover summary and test period dates)
  2) Encryption-at-rest details and key management owner (KMS/HSM)
  3) Data retention and deletion process for API logs

We'll also upload a short vendor intake form on our side once we confirm the SIG path.

Thanks — Lina
Lina Torres
Head of Security, Aperture AI
lina.torres@aperture.ai
Attachment: aperture_vendor_intake_form.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Initiate vendor security questionnaire: SIG/custom selection + evidence clarifications

Karthik / Dev — forwarding Aperture's reply. They want the full SIG and will be sending limited PHI in the pilot. Timeline: 10 business days for initial packet. Key asks from Lina: SOC 2 Type II (or solid summary + period), encryption-at-rest + KMS details, and retention/deletion for API logs.

Notes / next steps I propose: 
- Karthik: can you own the SIG mapping and fill the redwood-sig-mapping-template.xlsx? We should include exact control evidence and point to docs.
- Dev: please draft a brief note on encryption/KMS and retention that we can attach (1 page). Also confirm whether we can provide SOC 2 Type II report or only the summary for this timeframe.

Attachments sent to Aperture: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, redwood-sig-mapping-template.xlsx

Kim
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initiate vendor security questionnaire: SIG/custom selection + evidence clarifications

Thanks Kim. I can take the SIG mapping. Plan and recommended artifact list below (we can deliver initial bundle within 7 business days if we prioritize):

Recommended artifacts to attach to SIG packet:
- SOC 2: redacted Type II report (if Legal approves). If not available, include SOC 2 summary + control-owner contact and date range (we can provide).
- Information Security Policy (PDF)
- Encryption at rest: brief KMS summary + key rotation cadence (1 page)
- Data retention and deletion: API log retention window + deletion SOP (1 page)
- Network diagram (redacted) + hosting boundary (cloud region note)
- Third-party subprocessors list (vendor inventory CSV)
- Incident response contact + sample tabletop report (redacted)

I'll start populating redwood-sig-mapping-template.xlsx today and flag any controls where we need runnable evidence (e.g., audit logs). Dev — if you can draft the encryption and retention one-pagers today, we can hit the 7–10 business day window.

Karthik
Principal, Applied Security Operations
Redwood Inference
